# Cinemix

> Cinemix is a web application for discovering and managing movies, built with React and Node.js.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Dziopino/Movies-Frontend)
- [Backend](https://github.com/Dziopino/Movies-Backend)

## Application

- [Cinemix](http://localhost:5173/)

## Features

- Movie browsing and searching
- Movie details and ratings
- Movie genres
- Multilingual movie titles and descriptions
- User accounts and authentication
- JWT-based authentication
- Favorites and watched movies
- Admin panel
- User management
- Genre management
- Movie management
